title: The dispatcher forwards what it does not recognise (R1006 slice 1)
body:
Slice 1 of `docs/plans/oracle/subcommand-flag-forwarding.md` — **OD-10 / R1006**, evidence **BL-5**.

`uv run find-best-mobo aliases --check` now works. It is a stated deliverable and it has been unreachable since slice 4 shipped, because the top-level parser rejected `--check` before dispatch ever happened.

**`cli.py` parses with `parse_known_args` and forwards the leftovers.** It gains no table, no subparsers and no flag names — read the whole dispatcher and you will not learn that `--check` exists. That is the property OD-10 rejected a central subcommand table to keep, so a later stage with flags needs no edit here.

**The contract is stated in `commands/__init__.py`**, which is the file a new stage's author reads: a module MAY define `parse_args(argv) -> Namespace`; one that does not is dispatched through a parser accepting nothing.

**Forwarding does not mean accepting.** `find-best-mobo index --nonsense` still exits 2, now naming `find-best-mobo index` instead of `find-best-mobo`. Without that fallback, a fix for BL-5 would turn every typo into silence — a worse defect than the one being fixed.

**`--help` after a command name is now that command's**, which is settled by **OD-18** on BL-19 rather than proceeded on. `find-best-mobo --help` and a bare `find-best-mobo` are unchanged, exit codes included.

**`allow_abbrev=False`**, because with abbreviation on a future subcommand flag that is a prefix of `--config` would be *recognised* by the dispatcher and never forwarded — precisely the failure R1006 names. Nothing documents or uses `--conf`.

**New `tests/test_cli.py` drives the real `main`.** That matters: the rest of the suite calls `run` directly, which passes with the dispatcher completely broken — which is exactly how this stayed unreachable under 447 green tests.

9 new tests, 495 passing. Offline throughout.

Carries a merge of the base branch so the required checks run against the tree this will land on.
